explanation: OEIS A282779 (period of cubes mod n): 'Conjecture: let a_p(n) be the length of the period of the sequence k^p mod n where p is a prime, then a_p(n) = n/p if n == 0 (mod p^2) else a_p(n) = n.' periodOfPowerMod p n is the least T > 0 with (k+T)^p ≡ k^p (mod n) for all k, and the statement for prime p and n > 0 matches (e.g. squares mod 8 have period 4). Faithful.
